title: GoofySkytotem
description: A more goofy version of the skytotem pack.
body:
Changes the totem texture to a more goofy redesign of skyghost from interloper.

Credits:

- Javinaida for the redesign of skyghost. (check their art out here: https://bsky.app/profile/javinaida17000.bsky.social)

- Anomidae for the orignal model of skyghost seen in interloper. (check it out here: https://www.youtube.com/@Anomidae)

- Raquamarine for suggesting the name skytotem.

check out the actual texture pack here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/skytotem
